title: Halftone
description: Use for a comic or print halftone dot look over a scene, strongest at the edges (stylised intros, comic-book beats). Render cost: masks and rotates a full-frame layer, about +0.36 s/frame at 1080p (roughly 5 minutes extra for a 30 s film), so apply it to short beats, not whole films.
props: {children?: ReactNode; dotSize?: number /*18*/; color?: string; intensity?: number /*0.5*/; angle?: number /*45*/; drift?: number /*12*/; clearCenter?: number /*25*/}
